documentation: Docs/AbilityKit测试门禁与批量回归规范.md

P0.name: Development Blocker
P0.rule: Must pass before continuing feature development or submitting related changes.

P1.name: Contract Blocker
P1.rule: Must pass after runtime contract, networking, DI, or presentation-runtime boundary changes.

P2.name: Regression Baseline
P2.rule: Must pass before broad refactors, release candidates, or batch merges.

gates.name: precheck
gates.description: Fast local gate before continuing feature development.
gates.failurePolicy: Stop new feature work immediately. Fix the failing build or smoke test first.

gates.name: moba-codegen
gates.description: Build the framework and MOBA Roslyn components, enforce package ownership, and run generator/analyzer contract tests.
gates.failurePolicy: Block the change until all Roslyn projects build, ownership remains isolated, and compile-time contracts pass.

steps.name: Build MOBA source generators and analyzers

gates.name: moba-console-smoke
gates.description: MOBA console smoke tests that must pass before presentation/runtime follow-up work.
gates.failurePolicy: Block follow-up MOBA presentation/runtime changes until the smoke path passes.

gates.name: runtime-contracts
gates.description: Core pure-C# runtime contract tests for networking, DI and shared presentation runtime.
gates.failurePolicy: Fix contract breakage or explicitly update the design document before continuing dependent work.

gates.name: moba-network-options
gates.description: Fast MOBA battle data-plane option assembly contract: shared room-gateway preset, StateSync/FrameSync input serializers, retry semantics, snapshot/frame deserializers, and reliable-event cursor wiring.
gates.failurePolicy: Block MOBA network option or protocol preset changes until the focused dotnet contract passes.

gates.name: moba-acceptance-dotnet
gates.description: Unity-free dotnet acceptance verdict: parse real expectations via System.Text.Json, run the harness-free verifier over trace sources, and emit canonical batch_summary.json. Seed of the dsl-regression gate.
gates.failurePolicy: Fix the verdict contract break or expectation schema drift before continuing. Behavioral coverage grows as trace fixtures are added (needs-trace cases do not fail this gate).

gates.name: network-sdk
gates.description: Network SDK layer contracts: control plane (sdk/room), transport-neutral host lifecycle and integration, battle data-plane engine + config builder, and transport implementations (InMemory/LiteNet/WebSocket) loopback.
gates.failurePolicy: Block the change until the network SDK, battle data-plane, and transport loopback contracts pass.

gates.name: core-stability
gates.description: Core package correctness, stable-package warning baseline, namespace ownership, lifecycle, synchronization, allocation, and Unity direct-dependency contracts.
gates.failurePolicy: Block the change until core package tests, the stable-package warning baseline, allocation contracts, and direct UPM dependency declarations pass.

steps.name: Core tests and Public API compatibility
Core assembly and platform boundary audit
BehaviorTree runtime and node library tests
BehaviorTree Unity compile check (asmdef boundary mirror; skips if Unity absent)

gates.name: foundation-units
gates.description: Foundation leaf-package unit contracts: timer scheduling semantics, gameplay tag hierarchy/query/persistence, diagnostics profiler data, flow engine contracts, protocol wire serialization, and environment profile mechanism.
gates.failurePolicy: Block foundation package changes or leaf-package publication until the unit contracts pass.

gates.name: regression
gates.description: Batch regression gate for core packages and the main pure-C# test projects used before broad refactors or merges.
gates.failurePolicy: Treat as release or merge blocker. Triage by failing project and add/adjust smaller gates if needed.

gates.name: moba-content-contracts
gates.description: Run MOBA content contracts for package resource ownership, business ID governance, cross-table dependency integrity, trigger aggregate drift, configured presentation resources, and effective timing validation.
gates.failurePolicy: Block MOBA content publication until resource ownership, business ID governance, static dependency integrity, aggregate drift, configured resources, and effective timing contracts pass.

gates.name: moba-xiaoqiao-unity
gates.description: Run the authoritative Xiao Qiao Unity EditMode behavior and presentation-resource tests and persist matching command, log, and NUnit XML artifacts.
gates.failurePolicy: Do not claim the latest Xiao Qiao Unity result until the executed Xiao Qiao EditMode batch has matching XML result files in the gate output directory.

steps.name: Xiao Qiao Unity presentation resources authoritative
Xiao Qiao Unity Skill10020000 passive authoritative
Xiao Qiao Unity Skill10020000 passive refresh authoritative

gates.name: moba-lianpo-unity
gates.description: Run the authoritative Lian Po Unity EditMode scenario tests and persist matching command, log, and NUnit XML artifacts.
gates.failurePolicy: Do not claim the latest Lian Po Unity result until the executed scenario-test batch has matching XML result files in the gate output directory.

gates.name: moba-zhaoyun-unity
gates.description: Run the authoritative Zhao Yun Unity EditMode hero acceptance fixture as a scheduled regression baseline.
gates.failurePolicy: Treat as a P2 release and batch-merge blocker. Preserve matching Unity command, log, and NUnit XML artifacts for triage.

gates.name: moba-mozi-unity
gates.description: Run the authoritative Mozi Unity EditMode hero acceptance fixture as a scheduled regression baseline.
gates.failurePolicy: Treat as a P2 release and batch-merge blocker. Preserve matching Unity command, log, and NUnit XML artifacts for triage.

gates.name: moba-daji-unity
gates.description: Run the authoritative Daji Unity EditMode hero acceptance fixture as a scheduled regression baseline.
gates.failurePolicy: Treat as a P2 release and batch-merge blocker. Preserve matching Unity command, log, and NUnit XML artifacts for triage.

gates.name: moba-yingzheng-unity
gates.description: Run the authoritative Ying Zheng Unity EditMode hero acceptance fixture as a scheduled regression baseline.
gates.failurePolicy: Treat as a P2 release and batch-merge blocker. Preserve matching Unity command, log, and NUnit XML artifacts for triage.

gates.name: moba-config-sync
gates.description: Excel⇄SO⇄JSON 配置链的三方合并、删除传播与数组列编解码 EditMode 验证（Buff 表垂直切片，含 headless 流程所依赖的 excel-sync 核心）。
gates.failurePolicy: Block config tooling changes until the Buff Excel/SO/JSON round-trip, deletion propagation, and conflict abort tests pass.

gates.name: shooter-fast
gates.description: Minute-scale Shooter protocol, policy, runtime isolation, network, record, and benchmark contract tests.
gates.failurePolicy: Block the pull request until pure Shooter synchronization contracts pass.

gates.name: shooter-integration
gates.description: Gateway, Grains, Shooter client integration, smoke contracts, and wire compatibility.
gates.failurePolicy: Block the pull request or main branch update until cross-boundary synchronization contracts pass.

gates.name: shooter-unity-playmode
gates.description: Unity batch PlayMode smoke for Shooter client protocol and synchronization projection.
gates.failurePolicy: Block integration until Unity PlayMode emits a non-empty passing NUnit result.

gates.name: shooter-multiprocess
gates.description: TEST-01B minimal fault profile with isolated ports, bounded execution, cleanup, and complete diagnostics.
gates.failurePolicy: Preserve the complete run root and block scheduled/manual promotion.

gates.name: shooter-multiprocess-compatibility
gates.description: Scheduled orthogonal multiplayer matrix across Packed/PureState payloads, one/two join clients, fault recovery, reconnect cycles, observer reactivation, and deterministic latency/jitter.
gates.failurePolicy: Preserve all matrix manifests and block release promotion until the failing compatibility case is triaged.

gates.name: shooter-multiprocess-soak
gates.description: Scheduled/manual 16 and 64 observer PureState soak with dynamic network phases, delivery telemetry, recovery percentiles, observer fairness, and process resource trends.
gates.failurePolicy: Preserve all per-client telemetry, resource samples, summaries, and manifests; block release promotion on recovery, fairness, convergence, or memory-growth violations.

gates.name: shooter-multiprocess-ownership-cleanup
gates.description: TEST-01C dynamic matrix-timeout probe proving manifest-owned process cleanup, released ports, preserved timeout failure, and unrelated-process protection.
gates.failurePolicy: Preserve the acceptance report and timeout manifests; block promotion when any owned process or port remains, identity evidence is incomplete, or an unrelated process is terminated.

gates.name: runtime-performance-measurement
gates.description: Informational package and capability performance measurement for Attributes, Modifiers, Record, Targeting, EventDispatcher, Pipeline, and Triggering with reusable benchmark contracts and JSON artifacts.
gates.failurePolicy: Block when benchmark contracts, functional validation, execution, or artifact production fail. Metric values remain informational until a reviewed budget is approved.

steps.name: Runtime package and capability benchmark smoke

gates.name: shooter-performance
gates.description: Threshold-enforced AOI/LOD smoke and full performance profiles with JSON reports.
gates.failurePolicy: Block on benchmark threshold violations and archive the JSON report.

gates.name: moba-complete-battle-journey
gates.description: MOBA complete battle journey: formal World lifecycle plus Unity skill, projectile, buff, damage, death, respawn and settlement acceptance.
gates.failurePolicy: Block MOBA combat lifecycle promotion until both the Console World lifecycle smoke and Unity complete battle journey acceptance pass.

steps.name: MOBA Unity complete battle journey acceptance

gates.name: moba-smoke
gates.description: MOBA two-client TCP Gateway smoke: login, create room, join, pick hero, ready, begin loading, start battle, submit inputs, validate aggregated authoritative frame with both player inputs.
gates.failurePolicy: Block the pull request until the two-client MOBA smoke passes.

gates.name: moba-multiprocess
gates.description: MOBA host-only silo lifecycle + port isolation smoke. Currently runs the host-only silo as an independent process alongside the standard smoke to verify process isolation. Future expansion: true multi-client-per-process orchestration (requires MobaSmoke --client-only mode).
gates.failurePolicy: Investigate process isolation or port conflict before release promotion.
